live_defects_the_packages_remove.flow: CG_Submission_Endpoint (the live endpoint, not the copy)
live_defects_the_packages_remove.what: item/CurrentSequence is written from ?['CurrrentSequence'] — three r's. Portal Sequence Counters has CurrentSequence and no CurrrentSequence, so the expression resolves to null and the LOCK CLAIM writes null into the counter. Update_Sequence_Counter later writes the correct next value, computed from the read taken before the claim, so a single run self-corrects. Between the claim and the update the row holds null, and any concurrent run reading in that window coalesces null to 0 and mints a reference that has already been issued.
live_defects_the_packages_remove.package: the claim writes LockToken, ModifiedByFlowRun and Title only. It cannot touch the counter, so the window does not exist.
live_defects_the_packages_remove.note: The COPY exported earlier carried a different typo in the same area — item/Prefix from ?['YPrefix'] with a trailing newline. The live endpoint spells Prefix correctly. Two different corruptions of the same block, which is what an un-versioned hand-edited flow looks like.

notCountedAsDifferences: Whitespace inside expressions (coalesce(a, b) against coalesce(a,b)) and JSON key ordering. Both appear throughout and neither changes behaviour.

triggerFinding.severity: open, not blocking the paste closure
triggerFinding.what_is_wrong: The trigger carries no method restriction and no request schema. FLOW-BUILD-WALKTHROUGH C7.9, C8.4, C10.4 and C11.4 all instruct Method = POST, and every current-generation flow whose definition this repository holds carries method POST. With no method set the endpoint answers GET, PUT and DELETE as readily as POST.
triggerFinding.is_it_exploitable: Not directly. On a verb with no body triggerBody() is null, Compose_GetDocs_Caller coalesces to the empty string, the directory lookup finds nobody and the flow refuses. The cost is that the endpoint answers on verbs it should reject, and that a signed URL is that much broader than the one contract the platform uses.

getDocsClosure_2026_09_01.methodGap: Trigger configuration was never part of the comparison method used to close any of the fourteen flows — that method flattened actions and compared inputs.parameters. This finding surfaced only because the fresh export was read whole. The trigger method and schema of the other thirteen flows are therefore unverified, not verified-good.
